name: docdev
description: Create evidence-backed engineering documentation in MDX and optionally render it as a static Astro site.

interface.shortDescription: Author and render evidence-backed MDX docs.
interface.longDescription: Docdev creates development, planning, architecture, and library documentation from repository evidence, then optionally renders validated MDX through a static Astro site.
defaultPrompt: Create architecture documentation from this repository.
Draft an executable implementation plan in MDX.
Render my validated MDX docs with Astro.
